subject: Evaluation roadmap and MAP — Redwood + Medicor
raw_messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Ava Thompson <ava.thompson@medicor.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 5 Dec 2026 14:12:00 -0800
Subject: Evaluation roadmap & proposed MAP — Redwood + Medicor

Hi Ava —

Great talking earlier this week. As promised, I wanted to kick off a lightweight Mutual Action Plan (MAP) so we have a clear set of milestones, owners, and the decision timeline for Medicor's pilot + evaluation. Below is a concise proposal to confirm.

High-level goal
- Validate Redwood inference for Medicor's clinical summarization pipeline with latency <= 600ms p95 and cost targets aligned to the quantity estimates you shared.

Proposed MAP (summary)
- Week 1 (Dec 8–12): Alignment + kickoff working session — confirm stakeholders, evaluation criteria, data access
- Week 2–3 (Dec 13–26): Test payload runs — integration support with Redwood SDK, baseline perf metrics, initial quality check
- Week 4 (Dec 27–Jan 6): Iteration on prompts/quantization recommendations — cost/latency tuning and recommended config
- Decision target: Jan 10, 2027 — go/no-go + next phase sizing

Immediate asks for you
1) Confirm primary champion and day-to-day technical owner for the eval (who will accept test tokens and share sample flows).
2) Share any hard stop dates for procurement or compliance review that would affect the Jan 10 decision.
3) Confirm availability for a 30–45 min MAP workshop next Tuesday, Dec 8 at 10:00 AM PT (we can re-slot if needed).

Attachments: RDW_Recommended_MAP_template.xlsx (proposed MAP workbook with owners and milestones)

I'll populate the workbook with the items above and everybody's roles once you confirm. Rachel (cc) will run the technical coordination and bring in pricing support.

Thanks,

Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | (415) 555-0198

- Owners:
  - Executive champion: Ava Thompson (Medicor)
  - Technical lead: Liam Chen (Medicor)
  - Redwood technical contact: Rachel Kim (point for integration)
  - Redwood pricing/procurement: Karthik Iyer (cc'd on next note)

- Measurements we will capture during the test: p50/p95 latency, token cost per request, and NLL-based quality score + manual clinical review on a small set.

Attachment: Medicor_Eval_Criteria_v1.docx (short checklist of metrics)

Two quick asks before the meeting: could you drop a sample transcript (PII redacted) into the Drive folder linked below and confirm a procurement contact who should receive the Dec 20 cost worksheet?

Jordan
